chatbot-desc: Provides an interface to AI chatbots (LLM/GPT)
chatbot-i18n-welcome: Welcome to the localization file of the Chatbot extension.
chatbot-special-hdfviewer-intro: Embeds an AI chatbot in the wiki per [[Special:Chatbot]]. Currently only supports [https://github.com/h2oai/h2ogpt h2ogpt] e. g. with [https://github.com/OpenSemanticWorld/h2ogpt-cpu-docker-compose h2ogpt-cpu].
chatbot-confirm-redirect-help: If enabled, the chatbot asks for your confirmation before redirecting you to a new page
chatbot-custom-backend-iframe-src-help: If you are developing a custom backend you can paste the service url here for evaluation. Only origins allowed by the wiki configuration can be used.
chatbot-custom-backend-iframe-src-invali: This backend url is not allowed. Ask an administrator to add its origin to $wgChatbotAllowedBackendOrigins.
apihelp-chatbottoken-summary: Issue a short lived token that identifies you to the chatbot backend.
apierror-chatbot-token-not-configured: The chatbot backend token is not configured on this wiki ($wgChatbotSecret is empty).
